intent: Qualify a zero-effect source-neutral two-action VOI decision kernel and an immutable draft for FUTURE new on-policy external source first-use; do not create a runner workflow, simulator effect, or scientific outcome now

authority.approval_required: Separate explicit F6 on-policy first-use scope with named owner, exact SHA, new seeds/sessions, budgets and first-run witness. The historical F3 one-shot is spent and cannot be replayed.
authority.execution_os: Windows owner invoking WSL UID1000 with Python3.11 exact qualified runtime

source.api: source CartPoleWindPCH; Task(LearningRegime.do); env.reset(seed); env.do(policy), executed action 0/1, factual after state [x,x_dot,theta,theta_dot], reward, terminated/truncated
source.source_custody_license_note: Upstream checkout may be used only ephemerally in separately authorized source owner, never vendor source or redistribute code

predeclared_future_cohorts.seed_rule: base + 1000*block + index, block 0..2 and index 0..15; ensure zero overlap F3, OOD never generated
predeclared_future_cohorts.session_identity: world seed can intentionally be common across policies but each (split,block,index,policy) is independent new source session and must have fsynced BEFORE_EFFECT attempt; no unknown-effect replay
predeclared_future_cohorts.paired_caveat: same episode seed does NOT assure identical exogenous noise sequence or valid same-state counterfactuals for diverging policies

model_and_observability.key: Pure P80 preaction 4D state and desired discrete action encode into 16D normalized [1,tanh(x/2.4),tanh(xdot/3),tanh(theta/0.2095),tanh(thetadot/3.5),one_hot_action0,one_hot_action1,zeros9]
model_and_observability.label: 16D P80 observed effect tanh normalized state delta4+reward+terminated+truncated+zeros9, never before action
model_and_observability.learner_for_future: Identical source-neutral 16x16 causal RLS W and 16x16 P per policy, lambda 0.5, only real confirmed labels after do; capacity 512 floats per model. Model itself not trained by this engineering-only PR
model_and_observability.source_policies: observations before do only; no hidden simulator wind, targets, F3 future, or CAL and OOD leaks
model_and_observability.observation_goal: stabilize physical [x,x_dot,theta,theta_dot] using fixed positive weights [0.1,0.05,3,0.25] and raw state scales [2.4,3,0.2095,3.5]

selector.a_opt: Select action whose modeled expected information reduction k^T P Sigma P k / (1+k^T P k) is maximum; Sigma diagonal of public feature prevalence approximations from preregistered fixed [1,1,1,1,1,2,2,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0], no heldout data
selector.greedy_goal: Select action minimizing predicted one-step 4D physical stability penalty from W @ pre-action key, map first-four normalized output through clipped atanh to raw state deltas; compare two candidates
selector.physical_balance: Select action1 if theta+0.5*theta_dot>0 else action0, no learned model consulted
selector.guarded_voi: If A-opt candidate differs from greedy_goal, and predicted cost of A-opt is at most (1+epsilon) times greedy's predicted goal cost, choose A-opt; otherwise choose greedy. Tie-first deterministic

future_science_proposal.primary: World-mean actual source episode survival steps (higher better) against FIT-selected best of A-opt, greedy goal, physical-balance, preserve all terminal/truncated and short worlds
future_science_proposal.secondary: Physical state stability loss per observed step, realized reward; per-arm source call count/time, cost, action+receipt trace, cold retention for model checkpoint
future_science_proposal.threshold: At least 2 of 3 independent CAL seed blocks: candidate survival >=1.10x FIT-selected strongest baseline AND stability loss <=0.95x; prospective paired bootstrap 5000 resamples pooled lower CI relative survival gain >0; no post hoc tuning
future_science_proposal.best_control_selection: FIT only by highest survival and then lowest stability loss, frozen before CAL; strongest conventional must be competent and training/compute-qualified; all arms same max observation allowance and model capacity
future_science_proposal.wrong_credit: negative delayed action-outcome label matching, must worsen heldout factual prediction error; only on records that have genuinely occurred, no manufactured alternate outcomes
future_science_proposal.cold_retention: bitwise model state+readout before and after unrelated task only when separate task is admitted
future_science_proposal.risk: physical balance control may be strong; if all methods fail competence on FIT, no CAL or OOD science claim
future_science_proposal.source_firstuse_gate: Reverify authorization, owner custody, exact frozen experiment SHA, F3 historical source hash, ledger session uniqueness, original G4/G5/G7, native Windows/WSL preflight and all mandatory controls BEFORE env import or constructor

tests.allowed: pure source-neutral fixture-only deterministic decision kernels, source schedule uniqueness, strict state/vector/precision eligibility, zero oracle, no upstream import or real source resets/do
tests.disallowed: ever download/import/run pinned Causal-Gymnasium or create FIT/CAL/SCIENCE source in PR CI
tests.qualification: Existing original G4 full Windows+Ubuntu exact SHA, G5 native TTT both OS, G7 pinned Mamba2 Ubuntu; no new workflows

outcome.evidence_location: GitHub PR comments and existing workflow artifacts only
